title: Zay Flowers has big first half, but he's questionable with a hamstring injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Zay Flowers has big first half, but he's questionable with a hamstring injury
sources.description: Wide receiver Zay Flowers's first game since signing a long-term deal in Baltimore has been one of the biggest days of his career, but he won't be adding any highlights in the second half.
